base_historical.notes: Original source file. Tickers included TICKER-YYYYMM suffixes indicating removal month.

post_2019_patch.notes: add/remove change log format. Supplementary reference for cross-validation.

final_generated_source.notes: Updated consolidated file with clean tickers (no YYYYMM suffixes). Primary source used for YAML generation.

official_spglobal_reconciliation.notes: Official S&P Global announcements used to reconcile post-2019 membership changes. The 2026-06-22 event is announced but pending.

yaml_coverage: 2004-01-01 through 2026-06-02, plus the announced 2026-06-22 rebalance marked pending.
caveats: Historical S&P 500 data sourced from community-maintained repo. Research-grade accuracy.
Three official reconciliation conflicts remain around ticker-transition notation: BMS/AMCR, CBS/VIAC, and GDI/TT.
Tickers T, ON, Y, N are quoted in YAML output to prevent YAML 1.1 boolean misparse.
The 2026-06-22 rebalance is pending and must not be treated as effective before that date.
Pre-2004 data exists in source but is not included here.
note: Converted to internal canonical YAML format for point-in-time S&P 500 backtesting universe. Do not depend on upstream repo at runtime.
